# Keep and reuse your work

Keep the creation you just made in Lolly in a folder called **Northstar launch**, so you can return to it later.

Close the browser completely. Open the same browser profile again, return to Lolly, and find your creation.

Make a reusable template called **Northstar announcement** from it. Use that template to make a second creation called **Northstar next event**. Change some text or the link in the second creation and save it in the same folder.

Check that the original creation and the template still have their original content.
